Write a knowledge base / help article for: "[specific question or issue your customers have — e.g., 'How do I reset my password?' or 'How do I integrate with Zapier?']"
Product/service context: [brief description]
Target reader: [customer type and their technical level]
Structure: (1) Title (clear, matches what they'd search), (2) One-sentence summary answer, (3) Step-by-step instructions with numbered steps, (4) Screenshots/visual suggestions (describe what each screenshot should show), (5) Troubleshooting section — "If this isn't working..." with 2-3 common fixes, (6) Related articles section (suggest 2-3 topics to link to). Write at a [beginner / intermediate] reading level. Be concise — no one reads help docs for fun.
Give me the output in codeblock markdown format.

column2:
Create a comprehensive onboarding checklist for a new [employee / contractor] joining my [type of company] as a [their role]. Their start date is [date].
Break it into:
Before Day 1: Equipment/tool setup, account creation, welcome email contents, team introductions
Day 1: Agenda for their first day — meetings, reading materials, tool walkthroughs, lunch with [who]
Week 1: Key tasks to complete, people to meet, documentation to read, first small assignment
Month 1: Milestones to hit, first project, check-in meeting format and frequency, how to get help
Month 2-3: Expectations for ramping to full productivity, feedback cadence
Include specific placeholders for tool names, meeting links, documentation links, and contact people. Make this usable as-is — just fill in the brackets.
